snippet.title: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000 - BiliBili World Gameplay Video
snippet.description:
In the 41st Millennium, battles rage in every corner of the Galaxy. See more gameplay from Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000 shown to players at Bilibili World, 2026.

Forces are in orbit around a civilised world in the Armageddon theatre, under threat by an ongoing invasion of Orks. The governor of this planet has requested aid, and the Astra Militarum have joined the defence.
